months.title: Points expire after (months, 0 = never)
months.description: Each earned lot expires this many calendar months after it was earned; spending consumes the oldest lots first (FIFO).

grace_days.title: Grace days
grace_days.description: Extra days after the expiry month before points are removed.

notice_days.title: Notice (days before expiry, 0 = none)
notice_days.description: loyalty.expiring@1 is published once per member and expiry day this many days ahead.
